phases.name: web_first_and_bootstrap
phases.summary: Checked official pnpm, Corepack, workspace, and npm ci docs; selected work/install modes.
phases.bottleneck: Needed to select pnpm 10 because local Node is 21 while pnpm 11 expects Node 22+.

phases.name: manifest_and_lock_migration
phases.summary: Added pnpm workspace config and generated root pnpm-lock.yaml.
phases.bottleneck: npm overrides had to be moved to pnpm workspace overrides to keep audit clean.

phases.name: verification
phases.summary: Ran pnpm install, audit, tests, builds, customer checks, browser validation, and governance checks.
phases.bottleneck: Corepack-based scripts needed explicit corepack pnpm calls inside package scripts.

phases.name: closeout
phases.summary: Updated installation audit, registry, requirements, specs, history, omission, and evaluation records.
